import os, sys, json, time
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

os.makedirs('/app/runs', exist_ok=True)
r = Robot()

print('SPEC', json.dumps(spec, indent=2), flush=True)
obs = r.get_obs(video='none')
print('META', json.dumps(obs.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
for name, img in obs.last.items():

print('saved initial frames', flush=True)

def save_result(res, tag):
    path=f'/app/runs/{tag}'
    res.save(path)
    print(tag, 'meta=', json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
    for name, img in res.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(img).save(f'/app/output/{tag}_{name}.png')
    return res

def ee(rows, note=''):
    global obs
    res=r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32), video='mp4', note=note)
    obs=res
    return res

def joints(rows, dt=0.2, note=''):
    global obs
    res=r.submit('joint_position', np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32), dt=dt, video='mp4', note=note)
    obs=res
    return res

def look(seconds=0):
    global obs
    obs=r.get_obs(seconds=seconds, video='none')
    for name, img in obs.last.items():
        Image.fromarray(img).save(f'/app/output/latest_{name}.png')

import json
